notes.title: Class survivor game "不屈者传说 No Give up" Beta version, online!
notes.notes:
Hope you enjoy the game and have a great experience!

Dear player!

In the "不屈者传说 No Give up", face a swarm of monsters and a full screen of skills, enjoy the fun of meat pigeons and the thrill of battle! You can unleash blazing flames, or summon a mighty sword from the sky! Meet the battle, leave the legend, this is a journey only for you!

Now, the Beta version is open to experience three classes, six roles you can choose. Superb Athena, safe and reliable Steve..... More exciting content is waiting for you to unlock!

Getting started tips
Remember to choose runes before opening, it can help you better defeat the enemy
After learning passive skills, you do not need to equip the skills bar to take effect
Skills that have been acquired are more likely to come up again
If a new skill can be paired with an already acquired skill, we will recommend it to you

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171862/513c2daea79d63cfbb161c4f334d52b2f45cd152.jpg[/img]

Want to stay up to date with your game? Come and join our QQ group: 775423813, exchange ideas with like-minded players, share the fun of the game!

notes.title: "Next Fest" is now live, and the new class, Paladin, now available for trial!
notes.notes:
The trial version is packed with excitement!
You'll not only get to experience the two new Paladin heroes, "Steve" and "WangDaChui",
but also have the chance to tackle the new stage, "Lost Town" (which unlocks under specific conditions).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171862/217c80a7306695504055f02ef94f82a09a07e7d7.png[/img]

Throughout this roughly 4-hour journey,
you'll delve into each character's unique talents and abilities through the demo,
unlock ample rewards, confront powerful bosses,
and appreciate the boundless charm of the game's skill-reward synergy!

[list]
[*]Remember to choose your rune before starting, as it will aid you in defeating enemies more efficiently.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171862/513c2daea79d63cfbb161c4f334d52b2f45cd152.jpg[/img]

Thank you for downloading and trying out the game.      We hope to create an even more satisfying experience for our players.
For any feedback or suggestions, please join our QQ group: 775423813.
